600 genes against 2,864 features is a hard regime for any network.
A tie between the MLP and ridge at this size is genuinely ambiguous between 'the
features are exhausted' and 'the net had too little to learn from', which is
exactly why D5's learning curve is here rather than a capacity ladder alone.
The gene set is the intersection of three data sources and is smaller than any of
them; loop 210 measured it at 600 of loop 198's 1,336.
Nothing here changes the target. The requirement is a property of the relaxation
rule, and loop 210 is what re-measures that.
